logline_en: An original, clearly-labelled fictional micro-story: a regular customer's odd habit is misread as stinginess, then the withheld reason reveals hidden kindness.

evidence.claim: '진짜 강함이 뭔지 행동으로 보여준 사람' — 2,003,610 views, 169x its creator's recent-Shorts median (obs. 2026-10-31).
'천리마를 구해 오랬더니 죽은 말의 머리를 사 온 이유' — 416,589 views, 50x creator median; title withholds the reason.
'보너스 날마다 아빠가 사 온 크림빵, 반전의 반전이 숨은 정체' — 241,367 views, 3.3x creator median; repeated-habit + hidden-identity title.
'새벽마다 아들 빵집에서 빵 서른 개를 사 가던 엄마, 몰래 따라간 경로당에서 얼어붙었다' — 179,721 views, 8x creator median; same habit→follow→reveal structure.
'진짜 가치를 보여준 품격' — 1,004,582 views, 68x creator median, 176 s long.
Quote-led conflict title with withheld outcome ('…그 집이 누구 건지 몰랐다') — 620,762 views, 12x creator median, 167 s.

measured_facts: Topic clusters t30 (7 videos, 7 creators, median 12x creator baseline) and t29 (8 videos, 8 creators, median 9.8x) in run cr_topic_20261031_f84a18f2, all published 2026-10-18..30.
In t29 every member is 78–178 s long (median ≈ 146 s), longer than the 20–40 s figure claimed by secondary sources.
Titles in both clusters withhold the outcome or reason (…이유 / 정체 / …자 / 몰랐다); measured on titles only — the videos themselves were not inspected (metadata_only).
hypotheses: H1: The habit → misreading → withheld-reason → reveal structure transfers to a short, clearly fictional story and beats our account's median views.
H2: A 45–60 s version retains a higher average-view-percentage than a 120 s version of the same story (A/B the length; t29 suggests long can work).
H3: The reveal drives shares ('send to someone') more than likes; share rate above account median.
why_now: Two independent multi-creator clusters (15 videos, 15 creators) built on hidden-motive reveals outperformed their creators' own baselines by a median ~10x in the last two weeks of October 2026. Caveats: metadata-only evidence, one collection day, velocity not yet measured.
creative_principle: Show a repeated, slightly odd behaviour; let the viewer misjudge it; withhold the reason in the title and middle; pay off with a small, warm motive that recasts every earlier scene.
originality_notes: Original fictional story (no source plot, characters or lines reused) and on-screen disclosure '이 이야기는 창작입니다'. Several cluster members present unverified stories as true; we deliberately do not.
format: narrated text-story with scene cards, withheld-reveal structure, fiction disclosure

edit_plan: Even 4.5 s beats during the misreading (scenes 1–5), a slow drift at the turn (6), a hard shake on the act (7), then a longer, quiet reveal (8–9). The disclosure card closes.
audio_plan: Soft synthesized pad at -26 dB, riser into scene 7, single hit + ding on the reveal; master -14 LUFS. Placeholder espeak-ng voice — replace with a warm natural Korean voice before publishing.

success_metric: Views and share rate above our account median within 72 h; for H2, compare average view % of a 46 s cut against a 120 s cut.
